description: This file defines an interface (IController) for managing or interacting with controllers within the WPEFramework plugin host environment. It declares several pure virtual methods for persistent storage, deletion, reboot, environment retrieval, configuration management, and cloning of controller objects.

classes.name: IController
classes.description: An interface for controller objects providing methods for persistence, deletion, reboot, environment and configuration management, and cloning operations.

methods.name: Persist
methods.description: Persists the state or configuration of the controller.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified resource identified by the path.

methods.name: Reboot
methods.description: Reboots the controller or associated device.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Retrieves the environment information associated with the specified index.

methods.name: Configuration (getter)
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration for the specified callsign.

methods.name: Configuration (setter)
methods.description: Sets the configuration for a specified callsign.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Clones a controller with a new callsign from a base callsign.

ctags.name: IController
ctags.pattern: /^struct DEPRECATED EXTERNAL IController : public virtual Core::IUnknown {$/
